A — policy_name: Política e Estratégia do Mar – POLMAR (Resolução n.º 39/2017)
D — policy_objective: Consolidate a national agenda for sustainable, integrated multi-sectoral management of marine and coastal spaces; develop a profitable and sustainable blue economy; strengthen state sovereignty over jurisdictional waters; and address weak planning, monitoring and coordination of marine resource use including marine pollution and waste.
H — policy_type_justification: Council of Ministers Resolution n.º 39/2017 under Article 204(f) of the Constitution — national policy and strategy document (POLMAR), not binding regulation or parliamentary legislation. Revokes no prior decree; sets strategic framework for sectoral policies.
J — policy_sectors_list: fisheries, waste management, industry, tourism, municipalities, water, packaging
N — policy_budget_text: Pillar D strategies D.3–D.4: pollution taxes and user-pays fees for marine resource use; polluter-pays principle (sec. 15e) for prevention and elimination of pollution costs; no dedicated plastic budget allocation in resolution text.
R — instrument_description: Sec. 15e–f, Pillar D (D.3–D.4): Establishes polluter-pays and user-pays principles for marine/coastal activities; strategies require pollution from marine resource loss to be calculated and taxed, and project proponents to bear collateral environmental damage costs including waste and risk management.
U — instrument_implementation_text: Sec. 15e: "Princípio do poluidor pagador" — costs for "prevenção e eliminação da poluição"; Strategy D.3(3): "taxada a poluição que resulta em perda ou diminuição do valor dos recursos marinhos"; D.4: user-pays for project environmental costs.
W — comments: Strategic economic principle — implementation depends on subsequent legislation (e.g. Decree 45/2006 fees). Not coded separately: general access fees D.3(1)–(2).
